name: Huetter Mill & Cabinet
old_description: We are a full service custom millwork and stair parts manufacturer for commercial, residential new construction, and remodeling projects including stair installations. Our manufacturing location makes custom cabinetry focusing primarily on commercial and large high-end projects but we also ship nationally.
about:
Huetter Mill & Cabinet operates from Murray, Utah, where it was founded in 1948 by German immigrant Alfred Huetter. The business began in a chicken coop on the family property in Murray during the 1930s and 1940s, producing window sash and custom millwork. It remains a family-owned company, now led by President Gordon Huetter, Alfred’s son.

The company provides full-service custom millwork, including hardwood moldings stocked in alder, knotty alder, maple, poplar, cherry, and oak, as well as stair parts, handrails, and complete stairway systems. Its manufacturing facility produces custom cabinetry for large commercial and high-end residential projects, supported by an extensive inventory of custom knives for unique profiles. The firm maintains over $1.2 million in inventory on hand and ships nationally from its Utah location.

Huetter serves commercial construction, residential new construction, and remodeling markets, with a specialty in historic renovations. Notable projects include the Utah Governor’s Mansion, the Utah State Capitol, The Children’s Center, and O.C. Tanner renovations. The company also supplies schools, hospitals, tenant improvements, court buildings, and correctional facilities, and works with contractors, architects, and DIY customers.

The company’s stated purpose is to provide a financially sound operation for wholesale millwork and commercial shop products at reasonable cost, delivered efficiently by trained craftsmen. Its motto, “Quality and Craftsmanship live in our Name,” reflects an emphasis on material selection, advanced machinery, and skilled workmanship as differentiators.
